hints.title: Two-Phase Simulation Round
hints.text: Each second consists of two distinct synchronous phases: explosions across all triggered bombs, followed by gravity drops.

hints.title: Explosion Adjacency Check
hints.text: A bomb detonates if and only if it shares an edge with at least one box. It clears all boxes in its 8 surrounding neighbor cells.

hints.title: Static Box Propagation
hints.text: A box is static if it is in the bottom row, directly above a bomb, or resting on another static box. Non-static boxes fall by one row into empty cells below.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Bounded simulation until grid reaches stable equilibrium.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Premature cell overwrites during simultaneous explosions cause cascading race conditions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grid copies of size m x n ensure clean phase transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Carefully separates orthogonal trigger condition from 8-directional blast radius and static gravity rules.
